name: decisions
description: Skills for researching, deciding, and enforcing: create-research records a question investigated with per-finding confidence and cited sources, create-adr writes a proposed Architectural Decision Record (ADR) in MADR format that cites the research it rests on, refine-adr sharpens it with a short interview, approve-adr reviews it on substance and accepts it as standalone, append-only policy, and review-policy checks code changes against accepted ADRs.
